update_performance_or_crash: OS update causes slowness, freezing, app crashes, Wi-Fi instability, or general post-update degradation.
battery_drain: Abnormally fast battery drain or reduced battery life.
app_or_media_behavior: Specific app/media/multitasking behavior affected by device/OS.
account_or_verification: Verification code, login/account access, or similar account-level issue.
device_issue_other: Apple device problem not covered by the above categories.
